# Certificate expiry on internal service breaks a scheduled job

A nightly data-sync job fails; interactive access to the same service works fine.

Unlike the public-API cert incident, here the job had pinned a specific internal CA certificate that was rotated on schedule; the job's truststore was never updated, so only that client broke.

1. Confirm only the pinned-cert client fails while others succeed
2. Update the job's truststore with the rotated internal CA
3. Move from a pinned leaf to trusting the CA chain
4. Add the truststore update to the CA rotation runbook

Error Details
```
x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid; TLS alert certificate_expired (45); the job pinned an internal CA cert that rotated
```

Tags: security, certificate-expiry, x509, ca-rotation, truststore
